title: Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) IPO Details
intro:
Foodlink F&B Holdings IPO is a book build issue . The issue comprises of fresh issue of ₹192.00 crores and offer for sale of 88.35 lakh shares.

Foodlink F&B Holdings IPO opens for subscription on Nov 26, 2026 and closes on Nov 30, 2026. The allotment for the Foodlink F&B Holdings IPO is expected to be finalized on Dec 1, 2026. Foodlink F&B Holdings IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Dec 3, 2026.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2003, Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) Ltd. is a food and beverage services company engaged in providing premium catering services and operating casual dining restaurants and cloud kitchens. Headquartered in Mumbai, Foodlink caters to weddings, social celebrations, corporate events and other large-scale gatherings. Its restaurant portfolio includes brands such as China Bistro, India Bistro, Glocal and Art of Dum. The company also operates through its international subsidiary in the UAE, expanding its presence in the global food and hospitality industry.

As of September 30, 2026, we have operations in India, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom and Malaysia, and have catered for events in countries including Switzerland, Turkey, Italy, Spain, United Arab Emirates, France, Oman, Qatar, Egypt, Jordan, Maldives, Thailand, Nigeria, United Kingdom and Malaysia.

The company operate 28 Casual Dining Restaurants & Cloud Kitchens. These are located in India and United Arab Emirates with 15 Casual Dining Restaurants & Cloud Kitchens spread across two cities in India at 10 different locations, and 13 Casual Dining Restaurants & Cloud Kitchens in United Arab Emirates spread across two cities at seven different locations. The company have five centralised kitchens in India, located in Mumbai (Maharashtra), Ahmedabad (Gujarat), Mohali (Punjab), Hyderabad (Telangana), and New Delhi.
As of September 30, 2026, the company employed 1,481 people.
strengths: India’s largest organized, ultra-luxury and luxury catering (weddings, meetings, incentives, conferences, and event (“MICE”), sports, personal celebration catering and banquets) company in terms of Fiscal 2024 revenue amongst our peers in India, with a focus on casual dining, banquets and integrated F&B services.
Ability to deliver innovative and quality experiences leading to diversified portfolio of marquee customers.
Strategically located centralized kitchens with streamlined supply chain and well-established processes.
Experienced promoter and professional management team with domain knowledge.

faqs.question: How to apply in Foodlink F&B Holdings IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the Foodlink F&B Holdings IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for Foodlink F&B Holdings IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the Foodlink F&B Holdings IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .
